source.note: Quanser documentation-derived visual placement reference; not surveyed CAD/vector road geometry.

navigation_area.note: Only the documented outer navigation boundary is drawn; buildings, trees, fences and other obstacles create breaks inside it.

image.calibration: Aspect-preserving pixel mapping: full documentation image width = 500 m, image center = world origin, identical X/Y meters-per-pixel. This is a baseline calibration because Quanser does not publish image-pixel anchor coordinates for this workspace.

calibration.method: Aspect-preserving pixel-to-world baseline. Full image width is mapped to the documented approximately 500 m workspace width; image center is placed at world origin; X/Y use one common meters-per-pixel scale.
calibration.limitation: Official Cityscape/Townscape documentation publishes workspace size, navigation boundary, and common world coordinates, but not matching pixel coordinates in the navigation image. Exact Open-Road-style anchor fitting therefore requires user-supplied pixel/world anchor pairs.
